purpose: Track provenance recovery for independent island-mainland floral morphology systems without promoting abstract-level, non-floral, or unverified transcriptions to formal cross-system floral effects.

sources.title: The island rule and its application to multiple plant traits
sources.author: Annemieke Lona Hedi Hendriks

institutional_repository.name: Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington Open Access Repository

sources.next_action: Recover a stable institutional or author-distributed artifact, checksum the exact bytes, then re-verify Appendix B Table B9 and Appendix A island assignments before changing provenance status. Keep EIV as sensitivity unless reliability is empirically identified.
sources.claim_boundary: The reconstructed OLS response shape is directional replication evidence. An author-upload transcription is not treated as a checksum-locked institutional source, and the EIV envelope is not an empirical reliability estimate.

sources.title: Floral Trait Evolution of Angiosperms on Pacific Islands
sources.thesis_title: The Comparative Evolution of the Floral Traits of Island Angiosperms

known_routes.verified_metadata: MSc University of Toronto 2019; 136 island-mainland sister-taxon pairs across seven islands; catalogue advertises LAC, TSpace and Handle full-text links
556 species and 136 phylogenetically independent island-mainland contrasts; overall mean direction is heterogeneous among islands and families

sources.next_action: Resolve one advertised full-text route to concrete bytes, checksum it, then inspect appendices/data availability for the source-native 136-pair table. Do not reconstruct a slope or effect size from the thesis/article abstract.
sources.claim_boundary: Abstract and catalogue metadata establish the study design and qualitative heterogeneity only. They do not supply a source-native pair table, a compatible response-shape slope, or uncertainty suitable for the cross-system registry.

sources.title: Island influences on plant functional traits and trait-trait associations across species- and community-scales
sources.design_summary: 37 shared tree species across 35 eastern Chinese islands and 66 nearby mainland plots; 13 carbon-, water-, wood-anatomical, hydraulic, and size-related functional traits
sources.usefulness: Tests whether starting-value-dependent island compression extends beyond floral morphology, while preventing non-floral traits from inflating floral independent-system replication.
sources.next_action: Use only as an external boundary comparison unless a prespecified compatible non-floral synthesis is opened. Do not count its islands, species, or traits as a third floral-morphology system.
sources.claim_boundary: This study is relevant to the broader island-rule response shape but does not provide an independent floral morphology effect compatible with the current Southwest Pacific/Hendriks floral comparison.
